editorial: Step into a pop concert that turns into a living nightmare, as you watch in Trap the father and teen daughter navigate a sinister plot amid the thrumming crowd. The film turns the pulsating arena into a claustrophobic stage, making the family dynamic the buoy in a storm of terror. The signature long-shot that follows the crowd during the climax, shot in a visually intense single take, pulls the audience into a single breath where fear blooms on screen. Ideal for you if you crave psychological thrillers that toy with time and trust. The pacing lurches slightly in the middle, but the payoff justifies the lingering tension.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
